# 1. Setup

## - Setting work directories

Defining work directory within rmarkdown chunk

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
local_wd_folder = dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

```{r}
setwd(local_wd_folder)
```

## - Setting seed

This step ensures reproducibility in randomized processes

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 123, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
```

## - Options

```{r}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v3')
```

## - Loading palettes

```{r}
# Load additional colour palette packages
library(unikn, quietly = TRUE)
library(RColorBrewer, quietly = TRUE)
library(yarrr, quietly = TRUE)
library(scales, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggsci, quietly = TRUE)

# Define a set of custom color palettes from the unikn package
mix_1 <- usecol(pal = c(Karpfenblau, "white", Peach), n = 15)
mix_2 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_seeblau), "white", pal_pinky))
mix_3 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_bordeaux), "white", pal_petrol), n = 15)

# Display the custom palettes
seecol(list(mix_1, mix_2, mix_3), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 4, title = "Comparing palettes mixed from unikn colors", pal_names = c("mix_1", "mix_2", "mix_3"))

# Define a second set of custom palettes from the RColorBrewer and yarrr packages
brew_mix <- usecol(c(rev(brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Reds")), "white", brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Blues")), n = 13)
brew_ext <- usecol(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "Spectral"), n = 12)
yarrr_mix <- usecol(c(piratepal("nemo"), piratepal("bugs")))
yarrr_mod <- usecol(c(piratepal("ipod")), n = 9)

gradient_exp <- rev(c('#FFAB01', '#FC8805', '#FC5D05', '#D92211', "#D9043D", "#A6036D", "#7C038C", "#5503A6", "#A69AEE", '#D9D4F7', "#FFFFFF", "#F4F7FF", '#E9EBEF'))

# Display the second set of custom palettes
seecol(pal = list(brew_mix, brew_ext, yarrr_mix, yarrr_mod), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 2, title = "Using usecol() and seecol() to mix and modify palettes", pal_names = c("brew_mix", "brew_ext", "yarrr_mix", "yarrr_mod"))

# Define additional custom palettes from the scales package
natjournals_palette <- pal_npg("nrc")(10)
```

# 3. Loading per sample barcodes from ADT data

```{r}
sample_list <- list()
all_samples <- list.files(Input_data, full.names = TRUE)

for (n in 1:length(all_samples)) {
  sample_list[[basename(all_samples[[n]])]] <- file.path(all_samples[[n]])
}
```

```{r}
ADT_count_matrices <- list()
sample_names <- c()

for (sample in names(sample_list)) {
  dir <- sample_list[[sample]]
  sample_names[[sample]] <- sample
  ADT_count_matrices[[sample]] <- Seurat::Read10X(data.dir = dir)[['Antibody Capture']]
  rm(dir)
}
```

```{r}
for (count.mat in names(ADT_count_matrices)) {
  
  index <- match(count.mat, names(ADT_count_matrices))
  updated_barcodes_names <- paste(paste(substring(colnames(ADT_count_matrices[[count.mat]]),0,16),sep=""),'__', sample_names[index], sep = "")
  colnames(ADT_count_matrices[[count.mat]]) <- updated_barcodes_names
  
}
```

```{r}
bc_rename_dfs <- data.frame(
  renamed_bc  = character(),
  original_bc = character(),
  sample_name = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (count.mat in names(ADT_count_matrices)) {

  index <- match(count.mat, names(ADT_count_matrices))

  original_bc <- colnames(ADT_count_matrices[[count.mat]])

  sample_name_i <- as.character(sample_names[[index]])

  renamed_bc <- paste0(substr(original_bc, 1, 16), "__", sample_name_i)

  bc_df <- data.frame(
    renamed_bc  = renamed_bc,
    original_bc = original_bc,
    sample_name = sample_name_i,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  rownames(bc_df) <- bc_df$renamed_bc

  bc_rename_dfs <- rbind(bc_rename_dfs, bc_df)
}

bc_rename_dfs_filtered <- bc_rename_dfs %>% filter(renamed_bc %in% colnames(Merged.SeuratObj))

Run_S1081_L364A_bcs <- bc_rename_dfs_filtered %>% filter(sample_name %in% c('VA013_T5_GB', 'VA013_T5_ASB', 'VA013_T5_Ambiguous',
  'VA022_T5_GB', 'VA022_T5_ASB', 'VA022_T5_Ambiguous',
  'VA035_T5_GB', 'VA035_T5_ASB', 'VA035_T5_Ambiguous'))

Run_S1146_L364B_bcs <- bc_rename_dfs_filtered %>% filter(sample_name %in% c('VA013_T8_GB', 'VA013_T8_ASB', 'VA013_T8_Ambiguous',
  'VA022_T8_Ambiguous',
  'VA035_T8_GB', 'VA035_T8_ASB', 'VA035_T8_Ambiguous'))

Run_S1146_L364C_bcs <- bc_rename_dfs_filtered %>% filter(sample_name %in% c('VA025_T8_GB', 'VA025_T8_ASB', 'VA025_T8_Ambiguous',
  'VA038_T8_GB', 'VA038_T8_ASB', 'VA038_T8_Ambiguous',
  'VA059_T8_GB', 'VA059_T8_ASB', 'VA059_T8_Ambiguous'))

Run_S1146_L364D_bcs <- bc_rename_dfs_filtered %>% filter(sample_name %in% c('VA025_T5_GB', 'VA025_T5_ASB', 'VA025_T5_Ambiguous',
  'VA038_T5_GB', 'VA038_T5_ASB', 'VA038_T5_Ambiguous',
  'VA059_T5_GB', 'VA059_T5_ASB', 'VA059_T5_Ambiguous'))

Runs_bc <- list('Run_S1081_L364A' = Run_S1081_L364A_bcs,
                'Run_S1146_L364B' = Run_S1146_L364B_bcs,
                'Run_S1146_L364C' = Run_S1146_L364C_bcs,
                'Run_S1146_L364D' = Run_S1146_L364D_bcs)
```

```{r}
merged_fasta <- DNAStringSet()

for (run in names(Runs_bc)) {

  # -----------------------------
  # Paths
  # -----------------------------
  in_fasta <- file.path(
    data_folder,
    "Per_ChromiumLane_Mapped_Data", run, "outs/multi/vdj_b/all_contig.fasta"
  )

  out_fasta <- file.path(
    results_folder,
    paste0("VDJ/", run, "_all_contig.fasta")
  )

  # -----------------------------
  # Run-specific mapping: original_bc -> renamed_bc
  # -----------------------------
  run_bcs <- Runs_bc[[run]]
  map_vec <- setNames(run_bcs$renamed_bc, run_bcs$original_bc)

  # -----------------------------
  # Read FASTA
  # -----------------------------
  x <- readDNAStringSet(in_fasta)
  hdr <- names(x)

  # -----------------------------
  # Remove ONLY duplicate headers that have identical sequences
  #   - If a header appears >1x AND sequences differ, keep all and make unique.
  # -----------------------------
  tab <- table(hdr)
  dup_hdrs <- names(tab)[tab > 1]

  if (length(dup_hdrs) > 0) {
    keep_idx <- rep(TRUE, length(x))

    for (h in dup_hdrs) {
      idx <- which(hdr == h)
      seqs <- as.character(x[idx])

      if (length(unique(seqs)) == 1) {
        # identical sequences -> drop all but first
        keep_idx[idx[-1]] <- FALSE
      } else {
        # same header but different sequences -> cannot drop; make names unique for these
        names(x)[idx] <- make.unique(rep(h, length(idx)), sep = "_dup")
      }
    }

    x <- x[keep_idx]
    hdr <- names(x)
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Rename barcodes, keep _contig_X
  # -----------------------------
  barcode <- sub("(_contig_.*)$", "", hdr)
  suffix  <- sub("^.*(_contig_.*)$", "\\1", hdr)

  barcode_new <- unname(map_vec[barcode])
  keep <- !is.na(barcode_new)

  x <- x[keep]
  names(x) <- paste0(barcode_new[keep], suffix[keep])

  # -----------------------------
  # Write per-run FASTA + index
  # -----------------------------
  dir.create(dirname(out_fasta), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  writeXStringSet(x, out_fasta, format = "fasta")
  indexFa(out_fasta)

  merged_fasta <- c(merged_fasta, x)

  message("Processed + indexed run: ", run)
}

# -----------------------------
# Write merged FASTA + index
# -----------------------------
merged_out <- file.path(results_folder, "VDJ/Merged_Runs_all_contig.fasta")

# ensure merged headers are unique before indexing
if (anyDuplicated(names(merged_fasta)) > 0) {
  stop("Duplicate contig names detected in merged FASTA. Check renamed_bc uniqueness across runs.")
}

writeXStringSet(merged_fasta, merged_out, format = "fasta")
indexFa(merged_out)

merged_out
```

```{r}
VDJ_data <- read.table(paste(data_folder, 'VDJ', 'BCR_DATA.csv', sep = '/'), sep = ',', row.names = 'X',
                       header = T)

for (s in colnames(VDJ_data)[str_detect(colnames(VDJ_data), 'sequence')]) {

  VDJ_data[[s]] <- gsub("\\.", "", VDJ_data[[s]])

}

rownames(VDJ_data) <- VDJ_data$cell_id
```

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data$cell_id <- rownames(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data)

merged_data <- Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data %>%
  left_join(VDJ_data, by = "cell_id")

rownames(merged_data) <- merged_data$cell_id
```

```{r}
n_cells_without_vdj <- sum(is.na(merged_data$clone_id))
n_cells_with_vdj <- ncol(Merged.SeuratObj) - n_cells_without_vdj

percentage_cells_without_vdj <- round((n_cells_without_vdj/ncol(Merged.SeuratObj))*100,1)
percentage_cells_with_vdj <- round((n_cells_with_vdj/ncol(Merged.SeuratObj))*100,1)

###

n_cells_without_vdj_per_sample <- list()
n_cells_with_vdj_per_sample <- list()

percentage_cells_without_vdj_per_sample <- list()
percentage_cells_with_vdj_per_sample <- list()

for (s in unique(merged_data$Identity)) {
  
  n_cells_without_vdj_per_sample[[s]] <- sum(is.na(merged_data %>% filter(Identity == s) %>% pull(clone_id)))
  n_cells_with_vdj_per_sample[[s]] <- nrow(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data %>% filter(Identity == s)) - n_cells_without_vdj_per_sample[[s]]

  percentage_cells_without_vdj_per_sample[[s]] <- round((n_cells_without_vdj_per_sample[[s]]/nrow(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data %>% filter(Identity == s)))*100,1)
  percentage_cells_with_vdj_per_sample[[s]] <- round((n_cells_with_vdj_per_sample[[s]]/nrow(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data %>% filter(Identity == s)))*100,1)
  
}


```

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data <- merged_data

merged_data_to_export <- cbind(
    Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data, 
    as.data.frame(as.matrix(t(Merged.SeuratObj@assays$ADT@data[, rownames(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data)])))
  )

# Replace <NA> with NA (without angle brackets)
merged_data_to_export[is.na(merged_data_to_export)] <- ""

write.table(
  merged_data_to_export, 
  file = paste(results_folder, 'VDJ', 'Comprehensive_metadata.tsv', sep = '/'), 
  sep = "\t",  # Use tab as the delimiter
  row.names = FALSE, 
  quote = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(Merged.SeuratObj, paste(data_folder, 'SC_Objects', 'Added_VDJ.rds', sep = '/'))
```
